title: The Invisible Leash: Why RLVR May or May Not Escape Its Origin
abstract: arXiv:2507.14843v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances highlight Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) as a promising approach to enhancing LLM capabilities. However, it remains unclear whether the current practice of RLVR truly expands models' reasoning boundary or mainly amplifies high-reward outputs that base models already know. We introduce empirical support dynamics, a framework that quantifies how RLVR preserves, expands, and shrinks access to verified solutions. Applied across models, reasoning tasks, and training checkpoints, it matches verified successes question by question to reveal changes that aggregate accuracy can conceal. Across the evaluated model-level benchmark aggregates, \textit{the shrinkage of observed support outweighs its expansion}: more questions lose a verified success than gain one at the stated sampling budgets. These losses occur alongside gains in \texttt{pass@1}. Some RLVR models increase average token-level entropy

translated_title: 《无形的缰绳：为什么RLVR可能或可能无法摆脱其起源》
translated_abstract: arXiv:2507.14843v5 公告类型：replace-cross。摘要：近期的研究进展突出了可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）作为增强大语言模型能力的一种有前景的方法。然而，目前仍不清楚当前的RLVR实践究竟是真正扩展了模型的推理边界，还是主要放大了基座模型已经掌握的高奖励输出。我们引入了“经验支持动力学”这一框架，用以量化RLVR如何保持、扩展和收缩模型对已验证解决方案的访问能力。该框架被应用于多个模型、推理任务和训练检查点，通过逐个问题地匹配已验证的成功案例，揭示出总体准确率所可能掩盖的变化。在所评估的模型级基准汇总中，观察到的支持收缩超过了其扩展：在给定的采样预算下，失去已验证成功的问题数量多于获得已验证成功的问题数量。这些损失与pass@1的提升同时发生。一些RLVR模型增加了平均token级熵……
tldr: 该论文提出“经验支持动力学”框架，逐题追踪RLVR对已验证解的保持、扩展与收缩，发现在给定采样预算下支持收缩超过扩展，表明RLVR可能并未真正扩展模型推理边界，而主要是放大了基座模型已知的高奖励输出。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "empirical support dynamics" framework to track question-by-question how RLVR preserves, expands, and shrinks access to verified solutions, finding that shrinkage outweighs expansion at given sampling budgets, suggesting RLVR may not truly expand the reasoning boundary but mainly amplifies high-reward outputs the base model already knows.
